title: Forgotten Fossil Reveals New Dinosaur Species
excerpt: A dinosaur fossil overlooked in a museum collection for nearly a century has been identified as a previously unknown species.
body_html:
A dinosaur fossil that sat largely unnoticed within a museum collection for almost one hundred years has now been recognized as an entirely new species.

The specimen remained unexamined for nearly a century before researchers identified its unique characteristics, confirming it belongs to a previously undocumented type of dinosaur.

Further details regarding the classification and characteristics of the newly identified species are expected to emerge as the research continues.
